name: windandkite/module-storyblok-hyva-components
description: Unopinionated Hyvä component library for WindAndKite_Storyblok

suggest.magento/module-newsletter: Required by the newsletter blok (renders nothing without it).
suggest.magento/module-page-builder: Lets the google_map blok use the store's Google Maps API key instead of a per-blok key.
suggest.windandkite/module-storyblok-schema: Pushes these bloks' schemas to Storyblok and generates IDE hints (install with --dev).
